name: NVIDIA Corp
day_summary: NVDA fell −4.65% to $176.30 as a hot 172K payrolls print sent the 30Y above 5.0% and crushed high-multiple growth across the board. Puts and shorts paid; dip-buyers who stepped in early got run over. A rate shock, not a demand problem.

decision.rationale: Don't catch the knife on a macro break day. The selloff is rate-driven, not a crack in the AI thesis, so this is a HOLD — keep core, don't add until the tape stabilizes and the breakout level firms.

positioning.notable_flow: Put buying surged as the jobs print hit; vol bid hard into the close.

what_traders_are_doing: De-risking across high-multiple tech on the rate shock; NVDA was a source of liquidity on the down day even though the AI demand story was unchanged.

news.label: Hot 172K payrolls (vs 85K consensus) broke the equity framework — SPX −2.64%, VIX ~20.9, 30Y above 5.0%

outlook.short_term: Defensive into the weekend; watch whether the $176 breakout level holds on a retest.
outlook.long_term: Unchanged and bullish — a rate-driven drawdown, not a demand crack.

bull_case: Selloff is macro/rate-driven; the AI demand and capex story is intact.
Held above the 50-day on a brutal tape — buyers defended.
bear_case: ~40x forward is the wrong multiple to own when the 30Y is breaking above 5.0%.
